resources.string: macOS 26 (Tahoe) under QEMU on this phone, via OSX-KVM. macOS 14 (Sonoma) is still available from the Optional steps. Guest is x86_64 on an aarch64 host → TCG only, NO KVM. Expect it to be VERY slow; a full install may not finish. Flow: Debian chroot → install qemu-system-x86 → stage OSX-KVM → fetch Tahoe recovery → boot (VNC). No Apple images are shipped; you download them on-device. Apple EULA applies.
